verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that cloud and local sandboxes give Copilot isolated execution environments for safely working with code, tools, filesystem, and network resources, either locally or in fully isolated cloud environments. This matches the story directly. Cloud agents working in the background and MCP server allow lists add related containment. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of sandbox configuration (e.g. network egress policies and admin controls over isolation), and independent or hands-on corroboration that the sandboxing works as claimed.
